capabilities: Browse sessions from five agent backends
Stream live OpenCode chats and send prompts
Attach markdown notes and tags to sessions
Filter sessions by tag, state, model and directory
disambiguation: Not an AI assistant of its own; it browses and drives sessions created by external agent tools.
extras: Desktop only: it spawns sqlite3/zstd and talks to local servers. It reads agent history files outside the vault and writes only session notes inside it; no telemetry. In-app help covers the block syntax and filter language.
problem: Agent session histories live in tool-specific databases and JSONL files outside the vault, so Obsidian users cannot read or continue them from their notes.
